metric: (max/min)-1 of anchor genes' RPKM (gene length-normalised); lower = more coordinated

random_control_definitions.R1: anchor1 gene kept, second gene sampled uniformly at random (25 per loop)
random_control_definitions.R2: anchor distance preserved; random new start p1, genes at p1 and p1+d (25 per loop)
random_control_definitions.R3: R2 plus first-gene RPKM within 2x of loop anchor1 RPKM (up to 10 per loop)
